content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications received after 5:00 PM on 23 October 2026 will not be considered for the interview. The notification describes 27 October 2026 as the tentative interview date; candidates should check the institute's official website for any corrigendum or change.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Vacancy 2026 Out
content_sections.text: AIIMS Bhubaneswar has announced 3 vacancies under the ICMR-funded PERFUSE-AKI INDIA project. One vacancy is available for Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical), while two vacancies are available for Project Technical Support-II. The notification does not provide a category-wise vacancy distribution for these posts. Therefore, separate UR, SC, ST, OBC or other category-wise vacancy numbers cannot be confirmed from the supplied notice.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the educational qualification, relevant experience and maximum age requirements specified for the post they wish to apply for. The essential and desirable qualifications differ between the two positions. Essential qualification: A postgraduate degree in Life Sciences or Public Health, including integrated postgraduate degrees, with three years of post-qualification experience; OR a PhD. Desirable experience: Experience in clinical research or clinical trials, preferably multicentre studies in a critical care setting. Additional desirable skills: Scientific report writing, manuscript preparation, research publications and knowledge of research methodology. Research compliance knowledge: Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), research ethics, regulatory documentation, Clinical Trials Registry - India (CTRI), standard operating procedures (SOPs) and study monitoring. Data and software skills: Experience in data analysis using R, STATA or SPSS and knowledge of creating electronic case report forms (eCRFs) using REDCap. The postgraduate qualification with the specified experience and the PhD route are alternative eligibility pathways under the notification. Candidates should verify that their qualifications and experience meet the stated essential criteria. Essential qualification: 12th pass in Science subjects, a Diploma in MLT/DMLT or equivalent, and five years of experience. Desirable experience: Experience in the administration or coordination of research projects or clinical trials. Desirable computer skills: Proficiency in MS Office, including Excel, Word and PowerPoint, and electronic documentation. The notification does not specify a separate application fee or examination qualification for these posts. Candidates should not assume that meeting the minimum educational criteria guarantees appointment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Read the official recruitment notification carefully and confirm that you meet the essential qualification, experience and age requirements for the intended post. Obtain and complete the prescribed application form attached to the recruitment notification. Enter the required personal information, educational qualifications, experience details and other information requested in the form. Prepare the completed application for submission by email to [email protected] . Use the subject line format specified in the notification: "Application for the post of [Post Name]". Replace the placeholder with the exact post name for which you are applying. Send the email before 5:00 PM on 23 October 2026. If applying for both posts, submit a separate application for each post, as required by the notification. Keep a copy of the submitted application and email for your records. For the interview, bring the duly completed application form, original documents, self-attested photocopies of certificates and a passport-size photograph. No hard copy of the application form or supporting documents is required at the initial email-submission stage, according to the notification. Candidates must nevertheless bring the specified documents for the interview and subsequent verification.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: According to the notification, eligible candidates will be called for an interview or personal discussion conducted through an offline walk-in process. Initial scrutiny of applications against the specified age, qualification and experience criteria. Interview or personal discussion in offline mode for candidates called by the institute. Verification of original certificates and supporting documents. Final selection by the selection committee or appointing authority. The notification does not specify a written examination, examination syllabus, marks distribution or interview weightage. These details should not be assumed. Meeting the essential eligibility requirements does not guarantee selection.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Walk-in Interview 2026 Details
content_sections.text: Candidates should report at the specified venue with the completed application form and required documents. Since the interview date is tentative, applicants should check the official institute website for updates before travelling.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notification identifies the following documents for verification at the interview or joining stage, as applicable: Duly completed prescribed application form. Original educational qualification certificates and relevant mark sheets. Date-of-birth proof. Experience certificates. One recent passport-size photograph. Identity proof, such as Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID or Driving Licence. One set of self-attested photocopies of the relevant documents. SC, ST, OBC or disability certificate, where applicable. Applicants should bring their original certificates for verification. The notification states that candidates who fail to produce the required original certificates at joining, or whose documents contain discrepancies, may not be allowed to join the selected contractual post.
